utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’m coming to the repair drive this weekend. Just to confirm, what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great — thanks for coming! We’re still nailing down the exact time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please let me know as soon as the time is set, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Dane — the fence still needs help, so your hands would be great. I’ve got a couple tools we can use too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m on my way to the fence now. I’ll help sort the tools first, and we can get started right after.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll bring the tools over and meet you at the fence. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking in—did you find the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact room—did we decide on the community center again? Point me there, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I think it’s the community center again. I’ll confirm the room number and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Pia — that would help a lot. I’ll keep the updated list ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’ll stop by Sunday then—just let me know if the timing changes or if anything needs moving before that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — I’ll let you know if anything shifts, but for now Sunday at the community center is set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still coming by the repair drive and I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira—what do you still need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just bring any tools you’ve got and maybe some extra tape or screws if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve started the broken-things list, and I’m still filling in a few gaps. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks — I’ll wait for your list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m just tidying up the last few items now. Once it’s complete, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’m on it and will send the first urgent repair over as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Bo — I’m still not fully up to speed, so I’ll check what’s new and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem — just send anything urgent my way when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the repair drive is still at the community center—want me to check the exact room?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do. If you can check the exact room and note what’s broken, we’ll be in good shape to get the list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check the exact room at the community center and note what’s broken, then report back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m just trying to confirm the time so it doesn’t conflict with school pickup. Do we have a set time yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure we’ve locked it in yet, but I can check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I’m happy to help connect everyone for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — I just need to confirm: you’re still coming to the repair drive this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, I’m still coming this weekend — I’ll be there to help out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send over the broken items and names as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — that’ll help a lot. Once you send the broken items and names, I can get things moving right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll gather the broken items and names and pass them along soon, and I’ll keep spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, Leo. If you need me to pass anything along, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just yourself and maybe a good attitude — I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just send me the missing items, and I’ll bring what I can to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Leo — that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the list if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it’s still at the community center — I can check the exact room if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please check the exact room and let me know as soon as you have it. I’ve got the urgent list ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the exact room at the community center and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a basic toolkit, screws, tape, and a couple of wrenches—just let me know what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 10 a.m. works for me if it stays clear of school events.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—Saturday at 10 sounds good. If you still need hands, I can help with the fence too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that’d be really helpful. I’ll keep it on Saturday at 10 and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, are you definitely coming to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I’m definitely coming, and I’m still waiting on the broken items and names so we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Can you send me the broken items and names when you have them?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit out of the loop on the repair drive, so I should check what’s new and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No rush, Noah — just let me know once you’ve checked the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — I’ll check the details and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli — what’s still needed for the repair drive, and how many hands are we talking? I’m trying to make sure the timing and supplies are all lined up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. We could use a few more hands, and tools plus spare screws would really help—I’m keeping it low-key, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps — I can try to line up a few more hands, but I’ll need the exact time and a rough count of tools and screws so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just send me the updated list, and I’ll take a look at what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ll send over the updated list right now. Thanks, Oren; with you looking it over, we’ll have a solid plan for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rosa—I'll keep an eye out for it and get started as soon as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll send over what’s still needed. Thanks for helping out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — just send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can do at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll get the list together and send it over shortly. Appreciate you pitching in at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks—I'll keep spreading the word that the repair drive is on. Once Cleo’s list is ready, we’ll be set to get folks organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we’ve got and put together the list of anything still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks—once you’ve got it sorted, send the list my way and I’ll keep folks posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word and see who can bring tools or lend a hand. Keep me posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep repeating the plan and spreading the word about the repair drive. Keep me posted if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who can pitch in, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m in. Send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’m still checking what’s needed, but I’ll send you the list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rey—just send it over when you’ve got it and I’ll start inviting folks right away.
